entities.name: Query RNA polymerase Rpo1N
observations: 768 aa sequence; predicted molecular weight 87.5 kDa and pI 8.77.
Pfam domains RNA_pol_Rpb1_1 (PF04997), RNA_pol_Rpb1_2 (PF00623), and RNA_pol_Rpb1_3 (PF04983) span residues 12–691.
Homologs Q980R2, P31813, and B8YB53 are reviewed archaeal DNA-directed RNA polymerase Rpo1N proteins with 38.1–38.6% identity and 98.6–98.8% query coverage.
Best-supported role is a DNA-dependent RNA polymerase largest-subunit component forming the clamp-head region, not an independent soluble enzyme.
Homolog annotations report Mg2+ and multiple Zn2+ ions associated with the RNAP subunit/complex; exact metal stoichiometry is homolog-dependent.

entities.name: DNA-dependent RNA polymerization
observations: The reaction is annotated EC 2.7.7.6 and mapped to Rhea RHEA:21248/RHEA:14527/RHEA:17342 for close Rpo1N homologs.
The query sequence is inferred to participate in this reaction as part of a multisubunit RNAP complex; the sequence alone does not establish independent catalytic activity of Rpo1N.
